tools.name: check_server
tools.description: Grade a public MCP server against the current MCP spec: protocol, tools, OAuth discovery, security and speed. Returns the grade (A to F), the score, and every warning or failure with how to fix it. Takes 5 to 20 seconds. Only public https URLs can be checked.

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the MCP Check directory, which grades every public server in the official MCP Registry. Matches names, descriptions, tools and meaning, so "send email" also finds email servers. Best matches first.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get the latest MCP Check report for a server in the directory: its grade, spec version and every warning or failure with a fix.

tools.name: directory_stats
tools.description: Numbers across every server in the MCP Check directory: grades, spec versions, how many need sign-in, and the checks servers most often miss.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_server, search_servers · Public sink: search_servers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_server, search_servers · Public sink: search_servers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
